# Massey Ferguson 135 - Helpful References

Early MF 135 with Perkins AD3.152 diesel and round rear fenders. Use alongside the operator, Intertec service, and Perkins workshop PDFs in this folder.

## Key specs and tips

- **Engine:** Perkins AD3.152 / A3.152 family, 3-cyl diesel (~152 cu in). Workshop: Perkins TPD 1091 1208 E (file: Perkins AD3.152 - Workshop Manual.pdf).
- **Shared transmission / hydraulic / differential sump:** UTF meeting MF
